newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank sets repo at unchanged 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday set a one-week repurchase operation at an unchanged fixed rate of 4.10 percent at its regular weekly tender.
The reverse repurchase operation will run from January 15 to January 22. The Riksbank said all primary dealers were invited to leave bids by 0900 GMT on January 14.
Most market players had not expected the Riksbank to cut the repo rate, which was last lowered on December 17.
The repo rate is the Riksbank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity and the central rate in its interest rate corridor.
The Riksbank's other two key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, currently stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
